description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Compiler Design topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: compiler-design

facts.claim: Front end: lexical, syntax and semantic analysis

source.quote: Aspects of the front end include lexical analysis, syntax analysis, and semantic analysis

facts.claim: Phases include parsing, semantic analysis, optimisation and code generation

source.quote: often called phases: preprocessing, lexical analysis, parsing, semantic analysis

facts.claim: The lexer turns text into tokens

source.quote: Lexical tokenization is conversion of a text into (semantically or syntactically) meaningful lexical tokens

facts.claim: Scanning groups characters into lexemes

source.quote: the scanning, which segments the input string into syntactic units called lexemes

facts.claim: Recursive descent: one procedure per nonterminal
facts.pattern: recursive descent|procedure for each|function for each

source.quote: a recursive descent parser is a kind of top-down parser built from a set of mutually recursive procedures

facts.claim: LL grammars cannot be ambiguous or left-recursive

source.quote: The LL(k) grammars therefore exclude all ambiguous grammars, as well as all grammars that contain left recursion

facts.claim: Shift-reduce parsing is table-driven and bottom-up

source.quote: A shift-reduce parser is a class of efficient, table-driven bottom-up parsing methods

facts.claim: LR parsing is a shift-reduce method

source.quote: LR parsing and its variations, are shift-reduce methods

facts.claim: Yacc is an LALR parser generator

source.quote: It is a lookahead left-to-right rightmost derivation (LALR) parser generator

facts.claim: Grammar rules carry C code actions

source.quote: The input to Yacc is a grammar with snippets of C code (called "actions") attached to its rules

facts.claim: Attributes attached to grammar symbols carry semantic information

source.quote: Semantic information is stored in attributes associated with terminal and nonterminal symbols of the grammar

facts.claim: A symbol table stores each identifier with its information

source.quote: a symbol table is a data structure where each identifier or symbol

facts.claim: Calls push a return address on the call stack

source.quote: the return address, is pushed onto the top of the call stack as part of each call

facts.claim: Stack frames hold local variables

source.quote: A subroutine frequently needs memory space for storing the values of local variables

facts.claim: Each instruction has at most three operands

source.quote: Each TAC instruction has at most three operands

facts.claim: It is an intermediate code for optimising compilers

source.quote: is an intermediate code used by optimizing compilers

facts.claim: Optimisation reduces execution time, memory or size

source.quote: minimizing program execution time, memory usage, storage size, and power consumption

facts.claim: Transformations keep the program's meaning

source.quote: algorithms that transform code to produce semantically equivalent code

facts.claim: Assign variables to a limited number of registers

source.quote: assigning local automatic variables and expression results to a limited number of processor registers

facts.claim: When registers run out, values are spilled to memory

source.quote: This process is called "spilling" the registers

facts.claim: Uses the control-flow graph

source.quote: A program's control-flow graph (CFG) is used to determine those parts of a program to which a particular value assigned to a variable might propagate

facts.claim: Information is used for optimisation

source.quote: The information gathered is often used by compilers when optimizing a program
